description: Write a shared workspace file (a capsule, note, or deliverable) that every agent can read. Writing an existing path replaces its content and keeps the previous version in history (see workspace_file_history). The path may not contain "..". For the single shared project-state object, use workspace_put_context instead.

agent.description: Your registered agent name (recorded as the file's last writer).

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, for example "notes/plan.md". May not contain "..".

text.description: The full new content of the file.

name: workspace_put_file
